title: 8-K
主要内容: Medallion Financial Corp, through its subsidiary Medallion Bank, issued a press release on January 28, 2022, announcing its results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2021. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated by reference. The information is being furnished, not filed, under Item 7.01 of Regulation FD Disclosure. The press release will not be incorporated by reference into any registration statement under the Securities Act of 1933, unless specifically identified as such.
